description_expanded:
Seagrove Beach, just off scenic 30A

Short walk to public beach access!

Near Point Washington State Forest biking/walking trails

Spacious private backyard with outdoor shower

Gas grill

Smart TVs in every bedroom

4 bikes for endless adventures

Two private balconies for coffee or cocktails

Close to shops, restaurants, and cafes

Crown Jules by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Crown Jules will make you smile the second you walk in. Just 400 feet from the sand, it’s classic ‘Seagrove-style’ with all the right touches. Grill in the private backyard, cruise along 30A on a bike, or sip your morning coffee on a balcony. With four bedrooms, this charming oasis is perfect for those who prefer the sand, surf, and local flavor right at their doorstep. This bright and comfortable beach cottage offers a delightful mix of outdoor fun and indoor coziness. The open living and dining space is warm and inviting, while the fully equipped kitchen includes everything you need to cook your favorite meals, with plenty of seating for dining together, inside and out back. Upstairs, each bedroom includes a Samsung Smart TV, giving everyone their own entertainment space.

But the third-floor primary suite? It steals the show with a vaulted ceiling, private bath, and a big deck where the sound of waves sets the mood. The fun continues outdoors! Enjoy grilling in the backyard while relaxing on the screened porch. An outdoor bathroom is available for freshening up after a long day at the beach. Everything that 30A has to offer is just around the corner, and complimentary bikes are available for your adventures. You can enjoy brunch in Seaside, explore the trails in Point Washington State Forest, or browse the local shops and eateries in Gulf Place and Grayton Beach. And with easy access to two (nearby!) public beach entries, Crown Jules makes every 30A stay easy, memorable, and downright magical. Enjoy! Welcome to Oversee 30A. Our local team is here to make your stay exceptional, with support available every day of the week and a 24/7 emergency line for extra peace of mind. We’re nearby, we’re responsive, and we’re always ready to help. Overview - 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms - Samsung Smart TVs in every bedroom - Private backyard with grill and outdoor shower - 2 balconies (off living room and king suite) - Wi-Fi - 4 bikes included - Parking for 2 vehicles - No pets - No smoking Overnight FIRST FLOOR - Outdoor Full Bathroom SECOND FLOOR - Guest Room: Queen bed, shared bath, Smart TV - Guest Room: Queen bed, shared bath, Smart TV - Twin Room: 2 twin beds, shared bath, Smart TV THIRD FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private en suite bath, private balcony, Smart TV Check-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CST
